smyx-elderly-toilet-time-abnormal-analysis 1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Detects elderly entry/exit from bathroom using privacy-protecting human detection via camera, calculates occupancy time.
- Automatically triggers abnormal alert and notifies caregivers if stay exceeds safety threshold (default 30 minutes).
- Provides report listing, detailed alerting (severity levels), and integration guidelines for nursing home or smart home systems.
- Enforces strict privacy/data access controls and user identification (open-id) requirements prior to analysis.
- Includes step-by-step operation, API/script usage, and Mandarin/English documentation for deployment and compliance.
